name: Unbiased Bed Mesh
description: Kobra 3 and Kobra S1. Probes a full bed mesh with a tension-relaxing spiral approach per point, eliminating directional probe bias at the source, then writes the result into printer_mutable.cfg. Reboot the printer after a run to apply the new mesh. One-shot: leave the app disabled and use Start on its page when you want a fresh mesh.
